policies.sentence: Students must not use generative AI on graded work, assignments, homework, projects or exams.
Students must not use AI at all in this course, for any purpose.
Students must not use AI code-generation tools or coding assistants on programming work.
Students must not use named AI tools such as ChatGPT, Copilot, Claude or Gemini.
AI is banned unless the instructor explicitly allows or authorizes its use.
Using banned AI is academic dishonesty and a violation of the academic integrity policy.
Students must not get outside help or use external sources, web resources or other people, as well as AI.
The AI ban covers any use at every stage, including planning, checking, formatting, brainstorming, writing and debugging.
ChatGPT and other generative AI tools are not part of the official toolkit.
Students are expected to generate their own work in this class.
